parentSpanId.description: The ID of the parent {@link Observability.Span}. Root span does not have any `parentSpanId`.

actionContext.description: Action context associated with this {@link Observability.Span}.

startTime.description: The start time of this {@link Observability.Span}.

endTime.description: The end time of this {@link Observability.Span}.

actionId.description: The action ID associated with this {@link Observability.Span}.

parentActionId.description: The parent action ID associated with this {@link Observability.Span}.

attributes.description: A map of attributes associated with this {@link Observability.Span}.

status.description: The status code of this {@link Observability.Span}.

exceptionStack.description: The error stack trace for this {@link Observability.Span}.

traceType.description: {@link Type} of trace that this span belongs to.
